metadata.title: Coisotropy-one homogeneous spacetimes I: (3,2)-Kinematical Lie algebras with $d\geq 3$
metadata.abstract: This is the first of several papers devoted to the classification of coisotropy-one homogeneous spacetimes. It is the first step in extending the classification of spatially isotropic homogeneous spacetimes of kinematical Lie groups to the much vaster context of homogeneous spacetimes that are not spatially isotropic; that is, where the rotations no longer act transitively on the space of directions in each tangent space. In this first paper we classify (up to isomorphisms preserving the rotational subalgebra) a class of the relevant transitive Lie algebras, the so-called (3,2)-kinematical Lie algebras, for the coisotropy-one case in spatial dimension at least 4. As a by-product of this classification, we classify two-dimensional real representations of Bianchi Lie algebras up to a suitable notion of equivalence.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 一类非各向同性时空的Lie代数分类
analysis.workSummary: 本文是coisotropy-one齐性时空分类计划第一部分，分类保旋转子代数同构意义下的相关(3,2)-kinematical Lie代数，在摘要所述空间维数至少4的范围进行；附带分类Bianchi Lie代数的二维实表示。
techniques: 保旋转子代数的同构分类
analysis.breakthrough: 为非空间各向同性的齐性时空提供代数基础，超出旋转群在切向方向上传递的旧设置。
analysis.limitations: 只完成特定传递Lie代数类别而非全部时空几何分类。标题d≥3与摘要空间维数≥4的参数规范应查正文，不能仅按标题扩大范围。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。60页PDF提取完整、页数匹配、无短文本页，现有全文及元数据检索未见作者AI使用声明，补检及致谢复核亦未见正向声明；未披露不代表未使用。
